display_long_description:
Welcome to The Monkeys Place, a mysterious world filled with strange energy, hidden secrets, and unforgettable moments. What begins as a fun adventure with your friends quickly turns into something much darker. The air is thick, the trees whisper, and sometimes… you are not alone.

This game was made for players who love to explore, laugh, and experience a bit of fear along the way. Every corner of The Monkeys Place hides something different — some areas are peaceful, others are haunting, and a few will test your courage.

You can climb, run, and explore freely using your hands, just like a real monkey. Work together with your friends to find hidden places, solve small mysteries, or simply hang out and enjoy the chaos. There is no single way to play — it’s all about fun, creativity, and the moments you share.

The world of The Monkeys Place was built for everyone who enjoys multiplayer games with personality, humor, and a touch of horror. Whether you’re here to laugh, explore, or get scared, there’s always something new waiting for you.

Welcome to The Monkeys Place.
Enjoy your stay — if you can.
